**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Stop converting auth provider failures into 401 responses**

This middleware treats every exception from `_authenticate` as an authentication miss and returns `AUTH_REQUIRED` (401). If the auth backend throws due to operational issues (e.g., datastore/network outage or unexpected provider bug), clients get a misleading unauthorized response and the server-side failure is masked instead of surfacing as a 5xx. Only explicit auth-failure outcomes should map to 401; unexpected exceptions should propagate.
